results.title: Concurrent requests can repeat proof work after a cached result is stored
results.body_snippet: ### Observed on current `main` (`ae22fac`) `run()` checks the PR cache before it acquires the in-process prover lock. Two requests for the same uncached PR can both pass that read; after the first stores its result, the second can acquire the lock and start another fresh proof without rechecking the cache. results.author: tine1117
